links.outcome: Fabrication and harmful content in LLM answers to postoperative orthopaedic patient questions, by model
links.effect: Apertus had harmful content and fabrication in 22.5% of ratings (18/80 each); 11/20 responses had fabrication. Commercial models had fewer safety-relevant ratings. Overall scores: Claude 0.949, GPT-5 0.937, GPT-OSS 0.873, Apertus 0.693.
links.quote: Safety-relevant issues were concentrated in Apertus, with harmful content and fabrication each occurring in 22.5% of evaluated ratings (18/80).

screen.reason: The study evaluates and compares the performance and safety of locally hosted versus commercial LLMs on simulated postoperative orthopedic patient queries using expert physician raters, without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
